newsitem.title: CHINA: Joyce Boutique shrs fall on profit slump.
newsitem.headline: Joyce Boutique shrs fall on profit slump.

text.p: Shares of fashion retailer Joyce Boutique Holdings Ltd fell after the company announced a sharp fall in yearly profit, brokers said on Thursday.

"It was responding to the drop in earnings," said Edwin Cheung, sales manager at Taiwan Securities. "But the outlook for the retail sector is not that bad and we will suggest to buy on dips if the price falls further."
The shares fell HK$0.14 or 9.59 percent to HK$1.32 at midsession. Volume was 3.34 million shares worth HK$4.68 million.

Joyce reported a 62.7 percent fall in profit to HK$30.21 million for the year ended in March 1997. However, the company said it expected to return to operating profitability and achieve higher turnover growth in financial year 1997/98.
